claims.statement: The Vietnamese domain glossary is authoritative in /CONTEXT.md and covers Trips (Chuyến xe), Financials (Tài chính — Sổ cái ledger, Công nợ phải thu/trả, Doanh thu, Hóa đơn điều chỉnh, Phí quản lý, Lợi nhuận gộp/ròng, Thu nhập khác, Giấy báo nợ, Phân bổ lợi nhuận), Fleet & Personnel (Lái xe, Khách hàng, Nhà cung cấp, Forwarder, Lương sản lượng, Kỷ luật), Fuel & allowance, Penalties & salary, and System Audit & Tracking.

The trip lifecycle has 5 states: Mới tạo (CREATED) → Đang chạy (IN_TRANSIT) → Hoàn thành (COMPLETED) → Đã chốt (LOCKED) with ledger immutability, plus Đã hủy (CANCELED); transition enforcement lives in backend/src/services/trip-status-machine.service.ts.

Penalties (Kỷ luật) are salary deductions from the driver, recorded as Other Income (Thu nhập khác) in P&L — they are NOT company expenses; P&L Net Profit = Total Gross Profit − Management Fee − trailer/unassigned Expenses + Other Income.

Fuel modes are AUTO (Σ leg × norm × unitPrice), FLAT_RATE / Khoán (manual liters override), and an additive Supplement (Bổ sung); norms come from route records (fuel_empty_norm, fuel_loaded_norm) plus a 3L/trip supplement for standard routes; price = fuelActualUnitPrice ?? fuelPriceApplied snapshot.

Road allowance (Tiền đi đường) is computed as Tiền chuẩn (lookup keyed by Route × TrailerType) − (Số trạm × 55,000) ± Tiền vé ± Trả hàng, while Phí đường bộ is a separate annual renewable Expense Item, NOT part of per-trip road allowance.

Five roles exist with Vietnamese labels: Quản trị viên (ADMIN — full access, not a business user), Giám đốc (MANAGER), Kế toán (ACCOUNTANT — financial-fields-only trip writes), Lái xe (DRIVER — mobile portal), and Forwarder (FORWARDER); each role maps to a Casbin policy row in backend/src/casbin/policy.csv.
